Essentially it is something like "information processing." The Hypothesis is essentially "are we processing information at unnatural proportions?"

- This includes rate of processing, rate of context shifts, rate of un-related context shifts (particularly costly, i'm assuming), density of information, velocity of information, and essential dynamics (this is a concept from cybernetics, by ashby i believe..."
    

For example, a content creator today may be processing enormous amounts of categorical dispersion (temporary term) across a manifold of disciplines which would classicaly be outsourced to a single or multiple persons (this is the emphasis, the idea that in the past, work was distributed by profession...technology has essentially welded the boundaries between professions and professionals.) for example: filming, editing, sound-mixing, post-processing, publishing, interaction, branding, monetization. That is an enormous amount of work for a single person, often in uninterrupted long ters
